nodes.name: AuthenticatedStudentServiceImpl.java
nodes.summary: Resolves the currently authenticated user's Student record, creating one on first access, and provides locked variants for safe concurrent updates.

nodes.name: OAuth2UserServiceImpl.java
nodes.summary: Custom DefaultOAuth2UserService that resolves provider-specific (GitHub/Google) user info, creates or updates the local User/Student, links the OauthAccount, and returns a CustomOAuth2User principal.

nodes.name: PortfolioSlugServiceImpl.java
nodes.summary: Implements PortfolioSlugService by slugifying the user's name/email and appending a suffix from the user id until a free, unique portfolio slug is found.

nodes.name: UserServiceImpl.java
nodes.summary: Implements UserService: resolves the current user from the security context, looks up users by email, completes profile setup, and updates the avatar via Supabase storage.

nodes.name: CookieUtils.java
nodes.summary: Static helper for reading, writing, and deleting Servlet cookies, shared by both JWT authentication cookies and OAuth2 authorization-request cookies.

nodes.name: SlugUtils.java
nodes.summary: Static utility for converting arbitrary text into a URL-safe slug and generating a randomized fallback slug.

nodes.name: AuthControllerTest.java
nodes.summary: Integration-style test suite for the refresh-token endpoint, covering successful token pair refresh and unauthorized responses for blank, missing, or invalid refresh cookies.

nodes.name: AuthServiceTest.java
nodes.summary: Unit test suite for AuthServiceImpl covering login success/failure paths, refresh-token rotation and grace window, and rejection of expired/invalid/missing tokens or accounts.

nodes.name: VirtualMentorRetrievalFilterTest.java
nodes.summary: Unit test verifying that the virtual mentor's document-retrieval filter scopes results to global knowledge plus the calling student's own documents, preventing cross-student leakage.

nodes.name: AuthenticatedStudentServiceImpl
nodes.summary: Service that bridges Spring Security's authenticated principal to the Student/User domain, offering create-if-missing and locked-for-update lookup variants.

nodes.name: OAuth2UserServiceImpl
nodes.summary: Extends Spring Security's DefaultOAuth2UserService to normalize GitHub/Google profile data, provision or update the local account, and link the OAuth provider identity.

nodes.name: PortfolioSlugServiceImpl
nodes.summary: Implements portfolio slug allocation with collision detection against StudentRepository, retrying with a user-id-derived suffix until a free slug is found.

nodes.name: UserServiceImpl
nodes.summary: Implements the current-user, lookup-by-email, profile-setup, and avatar-update operations declared by UserService.

nodes.name: CookieUtils
nodes.summary: Non-instantiable helper class wrapping raw Servlet Cookie/HttpServletRequest/Response APIs for read, write, and delete operations.

nodes.name: SlugUtils
nodes.summary: Non-instantiable helper class with slugify() and generateSlug() for producing URL-safe identifiers.

nodes.name: AuthControllerTest
nodes.summary: Test class exercising the refresh endpoint's success and unauthorized-response behaviors against AuthService and AuthenticationCookieService.

nodes.name: AuthServiceTest
nodes.summary: Comprehensive unit test class for AuthServiceImpl's login and refresh-token logic, with builder-style helper methods for stubbing users, tokens, and requests.

nodes.name: VirtualMentorRetrievalFilterTest
nodes.summary: Test class verifying the retrieval filter used by the virtual mentor correctly scopes vector-store queries to global knowledge and the caller's own documents.

nodes.name: getOrCreateStudent
nodes.summary: Returns the authenticated user's Student record, creating and persisting a new one with an allocated portfolio slug if none exists yet.

nodes.name: getRequiredStudent
nodes.summary: Loads the authenticated user's Student record, throwing ResourceNotFoundException if missing, and backfills a portfolio slug if it is blank.

nodes.name: getOrCreateStudentForUpdate
nodes.summary: Locked variant that fetches (or creates) the authenticated user's Student record using pessimistic locking, for safe concurrent profile updates.

nodes.name: getAuthenticatedUser
nodes.summary: Resolves the User entity for the currently authenticated principal, throwing UnauthorizedException if not found.

nodes.name: getAuthenticatedEmail
nodes.summary: Reads the authenticated principal's name (email) from the SecurityContext, throwing UnauthorizedException when absent or blank.

nodes.name: loadUser
nodes.summary: Entry point overriding DefaultOAuth2UserService.loadUser: fetches the provider profile, resolves attributes, validates the email, provisions/updates the user, links the OAuth account, and returns a CustomOAuth2User.

nodes.name: resolveAttributes
nodes.summary: Selects the correct provider-specific OAuth2UserInfoInternal wrapper (GitHub or Google) based on the registration id.

nodes.name: fetchPrimaryGithubEmail
nodes.summary: Calls GitHub's user-emails API to retrieve the primary verified email when GitHub does not expose it in the base profile response.

nodes.name: getOrCreateUser
nodes.summary: Looks up a User by email, updating it if it exists or delegating to createUser to provision a new account.

nodes.name: createUser
nodes.summary: Creates a new User (defaulting to STUDENT role) and an associated Student record with an allocated portfolio slug and GitHub profile link.

nodes.name: updateUserIfNeeded
nodes.summary: Refreshes an existing user's full name and bio from the OAuth2 provider profile when they have changed, persisting only on an actual diff.

nodes.name: linkOauthAccountIfNeeded
nodes.summary: Creates an OauthAccount link between the local User and the OAuth provider identity if one does not already exist for that provider/providerId pair.

nodes.name: createUserInfo
nodes.summary: Wraps the raw provider attribute map into the appropriate OAuth2UserInfoInternal implementation, substituting a fetched GitHub primary email when needed.

nodes.name: allocateFor
nodes.summary: Generates a base slug from the user's name/email and probes for a free variant, appending a user-id-derived suffix on collision, failing after repeated attempts.

nodes.name: getCurrentUser
nodes.summary: Resolves the current authenticated user's email from the SecurityContext, loads the User, and maps it to a UserResponse.

nodes.name: getUserByEmail
nodes.summary: Looks up a user by the email in a UserRequest and maps the result to a UserResponse.

nodes.name: setupUserProfile
nodes.summary: Completes onboarding by applying the submitted profile fields to the current user's record and persisting the update.

nodes.name: updateAvatar
nodes.summary: Uploads a new avatar image via SupabaseStorageService, updates the user's avatar URL, and persists the change.

nodes.name: getCookie
nodes.summary: Searches an HttpServletRequest's cookies for one matching the given name and returns it as an Optional.

nodes.name: deleteCookie
nodes.summary: Expires a named cookie by writing a replacement with zero max-age and matching attributes to the response.

nodes.name: slugify
nodes.summary: Normalizes arbitrary text (lowercasing, stripping accents/diacritics, replacing non-alphanumeric runs with hyphens) into a URL-safe slug.

nodes.name: refreshReturnsJsonTokenPair
nodes.summary: Verifies that calling the refresh endpoint with a valid refresh cookie returns a 200 JSON response containing a new access/refresh token pair.

nodes.name: invalidRefreshTokenReturnsJsonUnauthorizedWithoutRedirect
nodes.summary: Verifies that an invalid refresh-token cookie yields a JSON 401 response rather than an HTML redirect.

nodes.name: refreshesTokensAndLeavesOldTokenInGraceWindow
nodes.summary: Verifies that refreshing a valid token issues a new pair while the old refresh token remains valid during its grace window.

nodes.name: logsInWithValidCredentials
nodes.summary: Verifies that a correct username/password pair produces a successful login response with an access/refresh token pair.

nodes.name: rejectsUnknownUsernameWithSameErrorAsWrongPassword
nodes.summary: Verifies that logging in with an unknown username yields the same error as a wrong password, preventing user enumeration.

nodes.name: rejectsSuspendedAccount
nodes.summary: Verifies that login is rejected for a user whose account status is not active.

nodes.name: rejectsMissingUser
nodes.summary: Verifies that a refresh attempt is rejected when the token's associated user can no longer be found.

nodes.name: rejectsExpiredStoredToken
nodes.summary: Verifies that a refresh attempt is rejected when the stored refresh token record has already expired.

nodes.name: retrievesGlobalKnowledgeAndTheCallersOwnDocumentsOnly
nodes.summary: Verifies the retrieval filter matches globally shared knowledge plus documents owned by the calling student.

nodes.name: scopesTheFilterToTheCallerSoOneStudentCannotMatchAnother
nodes.summary: Verifies the retrieval filter excludes another student's private documents, ensuring data isolation between students.
